newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-N'DORAM SIGNS FOR FRENCH CHAMPIONS MONACO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-N'DORAM SIGNS FOR FRENCH CHAMPIONS MONACO.

text.p: Chadian striker Japhet N'Doram is joining French champions Monaco from Nantes for about 23 million francs ($4 million).
Nantes said on Wednesday N'Doram, whose 21 goals this season helped Nantes finish the league championship in third place, signed a three-year contract on Tuesday.
Club president Jean Rene Thoumelin said the transfer fee was "close to 23 million francs."
N'Doram joined Nantes in 1990 from the Cameroonian club Tonnere Yaounde.

Nantes directors said the transfer fee would help the club to cover a financial deficit but they would be able to buy new players only if they also managed to sell forward Claude Makelele to Marseille.
Discussions between the two clubs have, however, reached a standstill with Marseille offering 12 million francs and Nantes wanting 14 million.
It is the third season in succession that Nantes have offloaded leading players.

They sold French internationals Christian Karembeu and Patrice Loko to Sampdoria of Italy and Paris St Germain respectively two seasons ago and Reynald Pedros and Nicolas Ouedec to Marseille and Espanyol of Barcelona last year. ($ = 5.753 French Francs)
